project_name: Municipal Asset Management and Permitting Software Solution
descriptor: A comprehensive system for managing municipal assets and permitting processes, integrating with existing city systems and ensuring secure, user-friendly interactions for both staff and public users.

requirements.statement: The system must replace the current Cityworks system for asset management, supporting approximately 80 asset-management users.
The system must be deployed on-premises, with an option for near-real-time database replication to City-managed servers if on-premises is unavailable.
The system must fully integrate with ESRI ArcGIS Enterprise 11.3, utilizing ESRI REST endpoint service layers for data exchange and maintaining GIS field values.

The system must support permitting processes including Code Enforcement, Planning, Building, Business Licensing, ACE Court, reimbursement agreements, and public-improvement/engineering/utility permits.
The system must integrate with the City’s Windows Active Directory for single sign-on and two-factor authentication, and document PII handling in the security architecture.
The system must integrate with Caselle, Granicus/311, ComplianceGO, Bluebeam Revu, Utilisync, and XpressBillPay using native connectors, REST APIs, or flat file exchanges.

stories.title: Deploy Initial System with Core Functionalities
stories.narrative: As an IT administrator, I want to deploy the initial system with core functionalities, so that the system is ready for further integrations and use.
acceptance: Given the system is ready for deployment, when the deployment process is initiated, then the system should be operational with core functionalities.
Given the system is deployed, when a core functionality is accessed, then it should perform as expected.
Trust: Given the deployment process, when it completes, then an audit log entry is created with deployment details.
failure_paths: Deployment fails due to network issues
Audit log entry is not created
stories.task_guidance: Deploy the system on-premises ensuring core functionalities are operational. Verify integration with Windows Active Directory for authentication.

stories.title: Integrate with ESRI ArcGIS Enterprise
stories.narrative: As a GIS analyst, I want the system to integrate with ESRI ArcGIS, so that asset data is synchronized with GIS layers.
acceptance: Given the system is connected to ESRI ArcGIS, when asset data is updated, then GIS layers should reflect these updates.
Given a GIS field value is changed, when I check the system, then it should show the updated value.
Trust: Ensure all GIS transactions are logged for audit.
failure_paths: Data mismatch between system and GIS.
stories.task_guidance: Use ESRI REST endpoints to connect and synchronize data with ArcGIS.

stories.title: Implement Asset Lifecycle Management
stories.narrative: As an asset manager, I want to manage the lifecycle of municipal assets, so that I can track and maintain them effectively.
acceptance: Given an asset is added to the system, when I view its details, then I should see its lifecycle status.
Given an asset's condition changes, when I update its status, then the system should reflect the new condition.
Trust: Ensure all asset updates are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop asset management features including inventory, maintenance scheduling, and condition monitoring.

stories.title: Synchronize Asset Data with GIS
stories.narrative: As a GIS analyst, I want asset data synchronized with GIS, so that spatial information is accurate and up-to-date.
acceptance: Given asset data is updated, when I check GIS, then the spatial information should be accurate.
Given a synchronization error occurs, when I review logs, then I should see error details.
Trust: Ensure synchronization logs are maintained for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Implement data synchronization processes between asset management and GIS systems.

stories.title: Develop Permitting Process for Code Enforcement
stories.narrative: As a code enforcement officer, I want to manage code enforcement permits, so that I can ensure compliance with regulations.
acceptance: Given a code enforcement permit application is submitted, when I review it, then I should be able to approve or reject it.
Given a permit is approved, when I check the system, then it should reflect the approved status.
Trust: Ensure all permit actions are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Create workflows for code enforcement permit applications, approvals, and rejections.

stories.title: Public Portal for Permit Applications
stories.narrative: As a resident, I want to submit permit applications online, so that I can interact with the city conveniently.
acceptance: Given I access the public portal, when I submit a permit application, then I should receive a confirmation notification.
Given I schedule an inspection, when I check the portal, then I should see the scheduled date.
Trust: Ensure all public interactions are logged for audit.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a public-facing portal for residents to submit applications and schedule inspections.

stories.title: Integrate with Caselle for Billing
stories.narrative: As a billing manager, I want to integrate with Caselle, so that billing processes are streamlined and accurate.
acceptance: Given the system is connected to Caselle, when a billing request is made, then the billing information should be accurately retrieved from Caselle.
Given the system is not connected to Caselle, when a billing request is made, then an error message should be displayed indicating the connection issue.
Trust: All billing transactions must be logged with a timestamp and user ID for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Ensure the integration with Caselle uses the provided API endpoints and adheres to the data format specifications outlined by Caselle.

stories.title: Conduct Final System Testing and User Acceptance
stories.narrative: As a project manager, I want to conduct final system testing and user acceptance, so that the system is verified for full deployment.
acceptance: Given the system is fully developed, when final testing is conducted, then all functionalities should perform as expected.
Given the system is tested, when a user performs acceptance testing, then no critical issues should be found.
Trust: Given the testing phase, when it concludes, then a comprehensive test report is generated.
stories.task_guidance: Conduct end-to-end testing of the system, including all integrations and functionalities. Ensure user acceptance testing is completed and documented.

stories.title: Enhance Security Protocols for User Authentication
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to enhance security protocols, so that user authentication is more secure and compliant with industry standards.
acceptance: Given a user attempts to log in, when the credentials are correct, then access should be granted with enhanced security protocols.
Given a user attempts to log in, when the credentials are incorrect, then access should be denied and an alert should be logged.
Trust: All login attempts must be recorded with IP address and timestamp for security auditing.
stories.task_guidance: Implement multi-factor authentication and ensure all login attempts are logged with necessary details for security audits.
